what: The plan validates the effective REPO after sourcing source-env.sh, but source-env.sh can overwrite a malformed argv --repo before validation
scenario_or_breakage: A direct call with --repo /abs and a source-env.sh that exports REPO=owner/repo would pass the proposed post-source validation, reach gh/state work, and violate the accepted fail-closed direct --repo requirement
suggested_fix: Preserve the parsed argv repo before sourcing and validate it immediately, or restore argv precedence after sourcing; add the malformed --repo regression with source-env.sh also exporting a valid REPO so the bypass is covered
